SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Human Origin as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Human Origin.

2. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nairobi
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

3. Which statement about Historical information is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Historical information as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Historical information.
   C. Explain Historical information with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Historical information never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

5. Which statement about Early Civilisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation.
   B. Explain Early Civilisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Early Civilisation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Early Civilisation as rumours only.

6. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

7. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal relationships is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   D. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Coexistence.

9. Which statement about Historical Development of Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historical Development of Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Development of Agriculture.
   C. Explain Historical Development of Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Historical Development of Agriculture as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Developments in Medium of trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Developments in Medium of trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Developments in Medium of trade never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Developments in Medium of trade as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Developments in Medium of trade.

11. Which statement about Maps and map work is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Maps and map work never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and map work.
   C. Treat Maps and map work as rumours only.
   D. Explain Maps and map work with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Slavery and Servitude is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Slavery and Servitude never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Slavery and Servitude with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Slavery and Servitude as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Slavery and Servitude.

13. Which statement about Self- Exploration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Exploration.
   B. Explain Self- Exploration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Self- Exploration as rumours only.
   D. Say Self- Exploration never happens in Kenya.

14. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

15. Which statement about Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6.

   C. Explain Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 as rumours only.

16. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Earth and the Solar System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Weather 5 Page 13 of 69 xiii 4.6 Fieldwork 10 5.0 Political Development and Gove and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
